retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-centric layout featuring large vertical outlined sans-serif text intersected by a diagonal script accent.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up male portrait with warm, sun-drenched lighting, characterized by a dominant vertical typographic stack on the left margin where large outlined letters are layered beneath a smaller, contrasting script element.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text alignment anchoring the left third
Diagonal script intersecting vertical block letters
Warm skin tones harmonizing with a soft-focus sunset background
Tight headshot framing with the subject looking directly at the viewer
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary display text
Outlined stroke treatment for the largest typographic element
Diagonal tilt of the secondary script text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale headshot occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical stack of outlined letters on the far left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move left to the vertical text, and follow the diagonal script back toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and large-scale type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and golden-hour oranges in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White outlines for the primary vertical text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep reddish-brown or burnt orange for the script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with soft, low-contrast lighting on the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and fluid casual script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick white outlines with transparent centers
Secondary text is a brush-style script with a slight upward diagonal slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stacking of letters rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric outline sans-serif paired with a fluid, organic script for textural contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy geometric skeleton of the vertical text.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait of a man with curly hair, lit by golden-hour sunlight, leaving the left third of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically-stacked uppercase sans-serif letters with a white outline on the left. Overlay a smaller, burnt-orange script word diagonally across the vertical letters.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text vertical and outlined?
Does the script text sit at a diagonal angle?
Is the portrait lighting warm and nostalgic?
Is the subject positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame?

mustRedesign: Horizontal text alignment for the main title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is rotated correctly.
Ensure the script text is legible against the outline text.
Verify the warm color palette is consistent across the image.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed toward the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Vertical Outline Sans + Diagonal Script Overlay + Warm Sunset Palette
